title: The decision module's explanations name the condition that really fails: a table of every input state with its reason and 'resolved by' text, then one repair of every wrong text, one test per state; texts only, no result changes the way it appears (backlog row DB-176; D-090 R258, R521, R522, R523, R524, R532)
objective: THE EXPLANATIONS ARE TRUE FOR EVERY INPUT STATE. The owner's reviewer found, by direct checks of the merged module that decides how each result appears, two withheld results whose stated reason is wrong (project-control/directives/D-090-product-plan-2026-09-28-start-building/source-055-amendment.md; docs/DISCOVERY_BACKLOG.md row DB-176): (1) `_unit_standard_way` in `services/api/app/scenario/three_answers/result_ways.py`: when evidence establishes that the lot is OUTSIDE a special density area, the legal dwelling-unit limit is withheld with the text written for 'not given': it says there is no evidence, and names as what would resolve it a sourced fact that the state already holds. (2) `_rear_yard_way`: when the corner reach is within 100 feet and the angle is over 135 degrees, the text says the far corner is 'beyond the rear-yard waiver area' and gives the distance; the failing condition is the angle. No test pins either text: the existing tests check that a withheld way HAS a reason, not that the reason is true of its state. STEP 1, THE INVENTORY, BEFORE ANY EDIT (the repository's rule on related failures: CLAUDE.md principle 17). For EVERY result that `decide_result_ways` decides, and for every text that the entry function `gather_result_ways` of task M5-T130 can return (`result_way_facts.py`, `result_way_bridge.py`, `result_way_bridge_overlay.py`: the statements of facts, the area statement, the held-back points), the builder lists every input state: every value of every input, with 'not given', 'not read', 'not stated' and 'unknown' among them, and every combination in which two conditions can fail together. For each state the table gives: the way (settled, conditional, withheld); the reason; the 'resolved by' text; the kind (missing information or owed work); and three checks: (a) the reason names the condition that really fails in that state, with the measured value where one exists, and names no condition that holds; (b) the 'resolved by' text asks for nothing the state already holds and for nothing that could not resolve it; (c) the kind fits: information missing for this lot against work the program owes (the owner's rule R258). The table goes into the report, complete, before the repair. CANDIDATES the orchestrator saw by reading; each is a claim to test, the builder's table decides: the corner branch when the reach is known and the angle is not (it gets the text for 'no outline'); the answer-level sentence that repeats the FIRST withheld value's reason for a whole answer whose values are withheld for different reasons; the unit limit for qualifying senior housing, whose reason says the formula sets no factor while its kind and its 'resolved by' text say work is owed; the rear yard of an interior or through lot, whose reason says inputs 'are not given' while its kind says owed work; the two short held-back strings of backlog row DB-175 (f). STEP 2, ONE REPAIR. Every row that fails a check is corrected in one change. TEXTS ONLY: for every input state the way of every result is what it is at the claim head (a test pins the way of every state of the table; the builder takes the 'before' column from the untouched module by script, outside the repository, and puts it in the report); no zoning number is added; no input is added; `decide_result_ways` and `gather_result_ways` keep their signatures. A KIND changes only where the table shows the kind itself is wrong for that state; each such change is listed in the report with its reason, for the reviewers to judge, because the kind is part of what the user is told. THE ORCHESTRATOR'S READINGS (the orchestrator's, said so in the code and the report, for the reviewers to confirm or correct; they continue the numbering of tasks M5-T129 and M5-T130): (O19) EVIDENCE THAT THE LOT IS OUTSIDE A SPECIAL DENSITY AREA. The work order decides what follows from no evidence and from a user's statement, and nothing for this state, so the result stays withheld as owed work (reading O10). The reason says that evidence records the lot outside a special density area and that how the legal dwelling-unit limit is shown on that evidence has not been worked out and checked against an independently worked example; the 'resolved by' text names that work, never a fact about the density area. Whether the limit should be SHOWN in this state is an open question; the report lists it; it is not decided here. (O20) THE CORNER BRANCH has three failing states, each with its own text: the distance only (the far corner is beyond 100 feet; the angle is within the limit), the angle only (the text gives the measured angle and the 135-degree limit and says the far corner is within 100 feet), and both (both are named). The two measures come from the legal-measure records the module already holds; no number is typed a second time. THREE RULES FOR THIS KIND OF CODE, learned in task M5-T129 (each cost a round there): (L1) NO DEFAULT STANDS FOR A FACT: every input's 'not given', 'not read' or 'not stated' state is carried as such; no truthiness test on a fact that may be unknown. (L2) ONE TEST PER INPUT STATE, WITH A TABLE: the report holds the table 'state, outcome, test that pins it'; each newly pinned branch is proved by one mutation outside the repository. (L3) TEXTS A USER MAY SEE ARE PLAIN AND TRUE: no internal name (a gap or reading number, 'the caller', 'milestone', 'reference case', 'packet', 'work order'), and no statement about which law text is captured, read or built into the repository; the guard test's battery covers every text. TESTS. One test per row of the table (parametrised cases are fine; each row is one case with its own id). Each asserts the way, the kind, and the meaning-bearing parts of the reason and of the 'resolved by' text: the condition named, the measured value, and the ABSENCE of the words of a condition that holds; not the whole sentence, so a later polish of wording does not weaken the check. RED PROOF: the tests for the two states the reviewer named are run against the untouched module first and fail; the output is in the report. One mutation proof outside the repository per corrected branch. The guard test's battery of texts covers every text of the table. NOT IN THIS TASK: calling the module from the engine; emitting anything; the contract, a schema or a fixture; a route; the website; a rule file; the review register (no zoning-rule behaviour changes: the ways are unchanged; the reviewers confirm it).
business_reason: A withheld result tells the user why it is withheld and what would resolve it. A wrong reason sends the user after evidence that is already given, or after the wrong measurement. The owner's reviewer requires the two explanations fixed before the module reaches users (R523); two faults of one kind in twenty results, found from outside, mean the same fault may sit in other states, so the whole table is checked before anything is fixed (R524). The owner's rule that missing information and owed work are kept apart (R258) is checked state by state.

risks: A text 'fixed' by changing what the result shows -> S6
Only the two named states repaired and the same fault left elsewhere -> S5; the reviewers pick their own states
Tests that pin whole sentences and break on a later polish, or that pin nothing of the meaning -> the tests assert the condition named and the absence of the wrong one
A file over the modularity warning threshold (result_ways.py is 526 lines) -> a new focused module in the same package
